title: Dawn of Skyrim - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 19 NPCs from Dawn of Skyrim.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by Dawn of Skyrim (Dawn of Skyrim.esp).

Install this if Dawn of Skyrim.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
author: skyrimnet
